en: Cross the checkpoint. Your path becomes wall.
zh_Hans: 跨过检查点。你的路径变成墙。

en: A loop prints a dense mirror. Walk cleaner.
zh_Hans: 回路会印出密镜。走得干净些。

en: The mirror is horizontal — dashes imprint the roof.
zh_Hans: 镜子是水平的——破折号印在屋顶。

en: Two checkpoints, two rewrites. Vary your route.
zh_Hans: 两个检查点，两次改写。变换路线。

en: Rotation. Your path prints on the opposite corner.
zh_Hans: 旋转。你的路径印在对角。

en: Habits solidify where you stepped. Do not re-tread.
zh_Hans: 习惯在你踏过处硬化。勿重蹈。

en: Boss. Leave a signature the lattice can read.
zh_Hans: 首领。留下晶格能读的签名。

en: A narrow spine. Your left becomes your right.
zh_Hans: 窄脊。你的左变成你的右。

en: Write on the floor; the ceiling answers.
Turn the chamber inside-out with one rotation.
zh_Hans: 一次旋转，把间室内外翻转。

en: Vertical and horizontal mirrors fire together.
zh_Hans: 垂直与水平镜同时触发。

en: A long hall of pillars. Reflect carefully.
Two horizontal folds. The middle remembers both.
zh_Hans: 两次水平折叠。中间记住两者。

en: Rotate twice — leave a staggered signature.
zh_Hans: 旋转两次——留下交错签名。

en: Symmetry lies. Choose which half becomes wall.
zh_Hans: 对称会说谎。选择哪一半成墙。

en: Boss. Both axes. Your path becomes a face.
zh_Hans: 首领。双轴。你的路径成一张脸。

en: Thicken under pressure. One path, no return.
zh_Hans: 压力下增厚。一条路，不回头。

en: A braid of corridors. Solidify once, commit.
zh_Hans: 走廊辫结。凝固一次，就承诺。

en: Tight lanes. A messy path seals everything.
zh_Hans: 窄巷。凌乱路径会封死一切。

en: Three checkpoints. Each rewrite tightens the net.
zh_Hans: 三个检查点。每次改写收紧网。

en: Rotation under load. Opposite corner seals exits.
zh_Hans: 负载下旋转。对角封住出口。

en: Horizontal mirror in a low room. Keep the floor.
zh_Hans: 低室中的水平镜。守住地板。

en: Thicken in a maze of choices. Hesitation fills cells.
zh_Hans: 选择迷宫中增厚。犹豫填满格。

en: Boss. Your habits become the only walls left.
zh_Hans: 首领。习惯成为仅剩的墙。

en: Master vertical mirror — carve with intent.
zh_Hans: 精通垂直镜——有意地雕刻。

en: Rotation as choreography. Land on the far mark.
zh_Hans: 旋转即编舞。落在远端标记。

en: Compose both mirrors with a short, sharp stroke.
zh_Hans: 短而锋利的一笔，组合双镜。

en: Three vertical mirrors. Conduct three phrases.
zh_Hans: 三面垂直镜。指挥三段乐句。

en: Thicken mastery — the buffer is almost full.
zh_Hans: 增厚精通——缓冲几乎满了。

en: Both axes, twice. Stack two portraits.
Boss. Final identity — sign the lattice.
zh_Hans: 首领。最终身份——签署晶格。

en: Epilogue. Same seed a friend can share.
zh_Hans: 尾声。朋友可分享的同一种子。

en: Hard. Less floor. Same lesson, less forgiveness.
zh_Hans: 困难。更少地板。同样课题，更少宽恕。

en: Hard. Final identity with less breathing room.
zh_Hans: 困难。最终身份，更少喘息空间。
